response.overview: As the new semester begins, Chaejin finds herself seated next to Mungyeong, a classmate with a bad reputation. At first, Chaejin feels uneasy around her, but over time, she starts to wonder if  Mungyeong is really as bad as everyone says.  Then one day,  Mungyeong suddenly asks to borrow Chaejin's socks. Caught off guard, Chaejin hands them over, only to hear whispers later that it wasn’t "lending" , it was "taking".  Confused and unsettled, Chaejin begins to question the strange dynamic between them. For the first time, she’s faced with a power imbalance, and she wonders what she should do next.
response.title: The house of Mungyeong
